verdict.rationale: Microsoft Graph documents a public REST API for driving Outlook programmatically. It covers drafting, sending, replying to and deleting messages, attachments, Inbox rules, search and sync, and mailbox settings, and it is usable from any language that can send HTTP requests. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of agent-driven use, and a machine-readable OpenAPI spec (the probed paths returned 404).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: Draft, read, reply, forward, send, update, or delete messages
